sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: contains meaningful beta-glucan soluble fibre. Oats are unusual among common grains for their beta-glucan content, which makes the fibre story more specific than just the fibre grams already shown. Easy whole-grain staple to use regularly. Plain rolled oats are cheap, familiar, and realistic for repeated use, which matters for an everyday grain. Plain oats start unsweetened. That gives them a cleaner baseline than sweetened instant oatmeal products, which are excluded from this entry.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: phytates can modestly reduce mineral uptake. That caveat is real for oats, even if it does not erase their mineral content. The bowl can get worse fast with sugary add-ons. The plain ingredient is solid, but common preparation choices can change the real meal a lot. Texture and tolerance are not universal wins. Some people dislike the texture or do not tolerate oats especially well, which is a real usability downside for a staple food.
